channel.title: Violations Watch: Afghanistan
channel.description: New incidents reported in Afghanistan. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: OCHA records 29 incidents affecting humanitarian access in Afghanistan in October, 11 linked to restrictions on women and female aid workers; Taliban interference the main obstacle
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Afghanistan. Types: Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Taliban authorities. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1035

item.title: Taliban detain two female health workers in Bamiyan for 24 hours for travelling without a male guardian
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Saighan district, Bamiyan, Afghanistan. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Taliban de facto authorities. Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0737
